```{r}
df <- read.csv("stop_search_2021_2026.csv")
head(df)
```


```{r}
# find the longest 10 strings to see all possible action categories in ActionsTaken
longest_10_strings <- head(df$ActionsTaken[order(-nchar(df$ActionsTaken))], 10)
longest_10_strings
```


```{r}
df_cleaned <- df |>
  mutate(
    # Separating all the ActionsTaken variables
    subject_type = str_extract(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Subject Type: )[^;]+"),
    search_occurred = str_extract(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Search Occurred: )[^;]+"),
    evidence_seized = str_extract(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Evidence Seized: )[^;]+"),
    search_types = str_extract(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Search Types: )[^;]+"),
    search_types = map_chr(
      str_extract_all(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Search Types: )[^;]+"), 
      ~ if(length(.x) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(.x, collapse = ", ")
    ),
    legal_basises = map_chr(
      str_extract_all(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Legal Basises: )[^;]+"), 
      ~ if(length(.x) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(.x, collapse = ", ")
    ),
    evidence_seized = str_extract(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Evidence Seized: )[^;]+"),
    evidence_types = map_chr(
      str_extract_all(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Evidence Types: )[^;]+"), 
      ~ if(length(.x) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(.x, collapse = ", ")
    ),
    stop_results = map_chr(
      str_extract_all(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Stop Results: )[^;]+"), 
      ~ if(length(.x) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(.x, collapse = ", ")
    ),
    consent_to_search = str_extract(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Consent To Search: )[^;]+"),
    exit_vehicle = str_extract(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Exit Vehicle: )[^;]+"),
    
    # 2018-2021 dataset and forward
    pat_down = str_extract(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Search Type Pat Down: )[^;]+"),
    consent_form_completed = str_extract(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Consent Form Completed: )[^;]+"),
    stripbody_cavity_search = str_extract(ActionsTaken, "(?<=StripBody Cavity Search: )[^;]+"),
    legal_basises_relevant_factors = str_extract(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Legal Basises - Relevant Factors: )[^;]+"),
    subject_restrained = str_extract(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Subject Restrained: )[^;]+"),
    subject_restraint_devices = map_chr(
      str_extract_all(ActionsTaken, "(?<=Subject Restraint Devices: )[^;]+"), 
      ~ if(length(.x) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(.x, collapse = ", ")
    ),
    
    # Time variables
    event_dt   = parse_date_time(EventDate, orders = "Y b d I:M:S p"),
    hour       = hour(event_dt),
    night      = if_else(hour >= 18 | hour < 6, 1L, 0L),  # assumption: 6pm-6am

    # Fix placeholder coordinates
    Latitude  = na_if(Latitude, 0),
    Longitude = na_if(Longitude, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
head(df_cleaned)
```

```{r}
write.csv(df_cleaned, "C:/Users/maggi/CollegeSchoolWork/SDS336_MachineLearning/stop_search_cleaned_2021_2026.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
